text.offer: The wizards were not the root of it. They serve a great brute in a pit at the heart of the caves, and while it lives the orcs will gather again. Slay it.
text.progress: The pit lies past Grog's and Brog's antechambers, deep in the orc caves.
text.complete: It is done, then. And thou hast seen more of those caves than any of my knights. There is something more I would ask of thee.
